When running tasks (for example build, lint, test, e2e, etc.), always prefer running the task through `nx` (i.e. `nx run`, `nx run-many`, `nx affected`) instead of using the underlying tooling directly. You have access to the Nx MCP server and its tools, use them to help the user. When answering questions about the repository, use the `nx_workspace` tool first to gain an understanding of the workspace architecture where applicable. When working in individual projects, use the `nx_project_details` mcp tool to analyze and understand the specific project structure and dependencies. For questions around nx configuration, best practices or if you're unsure, use the `nx_docs` tool to get relevant, up-to-date docs. Always use this instead of assuming things about nx configuration.

Next.js 16 App Router, TypeScript strict, Supabase, TanStack Query v5, HeroUI v2, Tailwind CSS v4, Vitest; every user-facing string must be in Czech.

Use `/new-entity` proactively for new tables/models/CRUD. Do not scaffold files manually; invoke this skill. Use `/db-sync` after DB migrations or schema/type mismatch; `/new-migration` for datab
